statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes contributing to symptomatic episodes
The denial reason is CO-97 (service is bundled into another covered procedure)
The submitted records document these clinical facts
